Every buffer under 32 GiB

PROBE
one prompt, one fixed seed
the answer is a deterministic function of one injected span,
so the correct attribution is known by construction

ORACLE run
full KV cache, nothing withheld
192.0 KiB/token, so 24.0 GiB at 128k context
against a measured 62 GiB fast tier at about 200 GB/s

sliding layers, a token past the 512 window was unreadable anyway

Report divergence AND downstream task accuracy,

span.p:
RISKIEST ASSUMPTION: that divergence localises at all.
It may smear evenly across every dropped entry, or flip one
critical token at negligible mean KL. If so the localiser
returns nothing and this whole plan changes.
